description: This file provides functions to fetch a project's name via an API endpoint, with a fallback mechanism. It includes two exported functions: fetchProjectNameDirect and a deprecated alias fetchProjectNameByProjectId.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect
methods.description: Fetches the project name given a projectId, using a dedicated API endpoint with a fallback to axios and base URL utility.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for compatibility.
